title: Ceiling logarithm of two
statement: The least natural number $k$ such that $2 \leq 2^k$ is $1$.
replaced:
The ceiling base-$2$ logarithm of $2$ equals $1$: $\lceil \log_2 2 \rceil = 1$, i.e.\ 
\texttt{Nat.clog 2 2 = 1}. This is a numeric fact used when comparing the
complexity of a binary protocol with its finite-message reformulation.
